summary: bctc-analyst escalation type 'bctc-data-quality-anomaly' has no dispatch handler — 5 HIGH escalations over 3 days drained to processed/ with zero board rows and zero signal_queue rows

finding.claim: The bctc-analyst blocked-cluster escalation path is absorbing, not routing. Signals are correctly written, correctly drained, and then folded with no actor assigned.
finding.not_a_dev_team_negligence_issue: Dev-team never declined the work — it was never presented as work.

evidence_raw.task_board_probe: jq over .task_board.rows[] matching /blocked-cluster|reparse|reprocess|Chưa có dữ liệu|bctc.*data.*gap/i -> empty
evidence_raw.get_recent_fixes_10: latest fix 2026-05-12 (HEADLOCK) — no reparse/blocked-data fix has landed

root_cause.mechanism: drain-signals.js moves any routable file (has from/source/type/signal_type) to processed/ and DB-inserts it. Dispatch judgment then runs at the dev-team layer against an actionable-type allowlist. 'bctc-data-quality-anomaly' is not a member of that allowlist.
root_cause.handler_checked: docs/agents/dev-team/flow/drain-esc-dispatch.md handles esc-deep-dive-request (spawns bctc-analyst opus deep-dive). It does not branch on bctc-data-quality-anomaly.
root_cause.consequence: Drain reports success, file lands in processed/, DB row exists — every observable says 'handled'. Nothing spawns. The failure is silent by construction, same class as the emitPressureStateTool existsSync miss in cow-20260721T151500.

blast_radius.growth_rate: 4 -> 21 tickers across 3 days; cluster expanded at every one of the 5 escalations
blast_radius.data_integrity: NOT corrupted — bctc-analyst correctly refuses to fabricate, downgrades to get_sector_comparison ratios only, writes no ledger entry. Cost is coverage loss, not bad data.
blast_radius.severity_rationale: HIGH on trajectory, not on current damage. The detector is working perfectly and reporting into a void; the cluster grows unattended.

recurrence_class.distinction: This is NOT 'recurring detection of a known bug' and NOT 'a fix that keeps failing'. No fix was ever attempted, because the work item was never minted. Treat as a routing defect, not a BCTC-pipeline defect.

two_defects_do_not_conflate.A_routing: bctc-data-quality-anomaly has no handler -> this row. Fix is in the dispatch layer.
two_defects_do_not_conflate.B_pipeline: filing-status calendar flips to ĐÃ NỘP before the parsed financial_reports row is queryable -> the actual BCTC bug the 5 escalations describe. Needs its own board row once A stops swallowing it.
two_defects_do_not_conflate.sequencing: Fixing B without A means the 6th escalation vanishes the same way. Fix A first, or mint B manually this once.

recommendation.action: PO decides: (1) add bctc-data-quality-anomaly to the dev-team actionable-type allowlist, or (2) route it via signal_queue instead of loose files so the queue drain picks it up. Then mint the pipeline board row for defect B with the 5-escalation history attached.
recommendation.router_did_not_implement: Dispatcher team boundary — cowork-team never spawns dev-team agents and never edits task_board directly. Filed as signal_queue row only.
